<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Switch between different api modes.

## Synopsis

```text
.api [0 | 1 | 2 | off | on | json] [compact=<yes|no>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Selects the reply format of the Director for this console session: mode 0 or off is text for humans (the default after login), mode 1 or on is terse text for scripts without table frames and catalog notices, mode 2 or json answers every command with a JSON-RPC 2.0 object. Without an argument it acts like .api 1. The mode lasts until the next .api or the end of the session.

compact=yes after 2 or json prints the JSON on one line, any other value switches back to indented JSON; after 0 or 1 it is ignored. An unknown mode or more than two words leave the mode unchanged. In modes 1 and 2 every reply is framed by CMD\_BEGIN, CMD\_OK or CMD\_FAILED and MAIN\_PROMPT.

Over gRPC each ExecuteCommand call carries its own response\_format and the Director does not remember .api; oconsole --grpc remembers the mode chosen with .api and sends it with every following command, so .api behaves as over BNET.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<mode>` | enum | `0`, `1`, `2`, `off`, `on`, `json` |  | positional | API mode. |
| `compact=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Compact JSON. |

## Examples

Switch to JSON replies:

```text
.api 2
```

JSON replies on a single line:

```text
.api json compact=yes
```

Back to text mode:

```text
.api 0
```
